correctness.rationale: Four-point Fourier orthogonality is exactly the pairwise zero-difference condition for P(z)=a+bz+cz²+dz³. Real cubic geometry gives only the phase possibilities -1 and a conjugate unit-circle pair. Any 3-clique forces primitive 3rd roots or all nontrivial 4th roots; factorization gives b=c=a+d or equal weights. Dimension-four unitary rows force equal weights for 4 characters. Exact pair criterion is P(-1)=0 or the quadratic factor z²-2tz+1 with t=(d-b)/(2a) in (-1,1). All directions and boundary inclusions were checked analytically; standalone checker confirms 81 exact rational factor evaluations and 1296 finite cases but is not used for the universal proof.

value.rationale: The natural unresolved weighted analog of finite Fourier-Hadamard packing admits four qualitatively different maximal-cardinality regimes, including a full nonuniform 3-mode family and a sharp real algebraic transition between two and one modes. Exact classification of all positive masses and equality frequency families is a structural invariant of weighted Fourier sampling, rather than a fixed small-case recomputation. The computation is auxiliary and the classification is motivated by 2026 finite spectral-pair research.
